_comment: Recurring jobs, as data: adding the next one means adding an entry here,
not writing code. JSON rather than YAML because the runner ships in the
backend image and PyYAML is not one of its dependencies -- a scheduler
that needs a new dependency to read its own job list is not future-proof.
schedule  five-field cron, evaluated in UTC.
command   argv, run without a shell, so no quoting traps.
why       printed by `list` and in every log line. A job nobody can
explain is a job nobody dares delete.
Nothing retries on its own. A failed import that retried would hide a
genuinely broken feed behind three more failures, and the next scheduled
run is the retry -- a weekly job has six days of slack.

jobs.name: cache-sweep
jobs.why: Keeps the disk cache under APP_CACHE_MAX_BYTES. Nightly, because a ceiling that is never swept to is not a ceiling.

jobs.name: freigaben-sweep
jobs.why: Entfernt abgelaufene geteilte Links. Eine Freigabe ist eine Momentaufnahme und bleibt liegen, bis jemand sie wegräumt; ohne diesen Lauf wächst die Tabelle unbegrenzt. Ein Betrieb ohne Serverspeicher meldet das und tut nichts.

jobs.name: poi-index
jobs.why: The OpenStreetMap places behind /api/nearby. Quarterly is the cadence the Overpass policy is content with. The API reads its index at startup, so the backend has to be restarted after a rebuild for the new one to take effect.

jobs.name: address-index
jobs.why: The official Saxon address coordinates. The GeoSN republishes quarterly. The API reads its index at startup, so the backend has to be restarted after a rebuild for the new one to take effect.
